indicators.note: correcting suggests putting the letters of the two words right by rearranging them

explanation.surface: Someone is being told off for speaking rashly while revising a text.
explanation.walkthrough: 'correcting' rearranges the ten letters of APPEAR RASH.
explanation.definitionFit: Restating a passage in other words is exactly what a rewording does.

clue.text: Ruth accepted General Secretary had gone into animal home

indicators.note: accepted means the word for ruth takes in the abbreviation, holding it inside

parts.note: ruth is an old word for pity or compassion

explanation.surface: A woman named Ruth let a union boss into a shelter for animals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ruth' looks like a woman's name but is an old noun meaning compassion; 'had gone into' is a link restating the containment.
explanation.definitionFit: A sty is the enclosure where pigs are kept, a home for farm animals.

parts.note: stock here means livestock, and taking it under cover of darkness is cattle theft

explanation.definitionFit: To steal cattle or horses is the rural crime of the cattle thief, often done after dark.

parts.note: not someone scanning a newspaper but one who reads the lines and bumps of a head to judge character

explanation.definitionFit: A practitioner of the old pseudoscience judged personality from the shape of the skull.

parts.note: to hurry is to run
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: Someone is told to rush eastward in search of an occult sign.
explanation.definitionFit: Old Germanic letters were credited with magical power, so they serve as mystic symbols.

indicators.note: suffering signals the letters of the two words are in a disturbed, damaged state

explanation.surface: Men in need of comfort are overcome with sleepiness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffering' rearranges CONSOLE MEN; 'from' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleepiness or heaviness of the eyes is the state of drowsiness.

clue.text: A society girl making a come-back although retired

indicators.note: making a come-back means the word for a debutante is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: a deb (debutante) is a young woman entering high society

explanation.surface: A debutante attempts a comeback despite having stepped away from society.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making a come-back' turns DEB into BED; 'although' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has retired for the night has gone to bed, so they are in bed.

definitions.meaning: in cricket a shot reaching the rope scores four runs
the edge or border of an area

explanation.definitionFit: A cricket shot to the rope scores four, and the same word means a dividing line or border.

clue.text: Some indeed who are no longer with us

definitions.text: Some indeed who are no longer with us

parts.words: Some indeed who are no longer with us
parts.note: a euphemistic description of people who have died

explanation.definitionFit: The dead are euphemistically said to be no longer with us, having passed on.

clue.text: Germany's capital stargazer detailed the gourmet

indicators.note: capital means the first letter of the word for the country
detailed means the stargazer word has its tail, its last letter, cut off

parts.note: an astronomer studies the stars

explanation.surface: A German astronomer gives a detailed account of a food lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' reads as 'thorough' but means de-tailed: ASTRONOMER loses its final R. 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A connoisseur of fine food and cooking is a gourmet.

definitions.meaning: as in 'like it or ... it', to tolerate something unwelcome

explanation.definitionFit: A single total amount is a lump sum, and 'lump it' means to tolerate grudgingly.

clue.text: Trusted leader has plump female shape

parts.note: plump means fat
her is the female pronoun
a figure is a body's shape

explanation.surface: A dependable boss is described as a rather stout woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A man looked up to for guidance and protection plays the paternal role of a trusted leader.

clue.text: Doing some interior decorating on the roof?

definitions.text: Doing some interior decorating on the roof?

parts.words: Doing some interior decorating on the roof?
parts.note: laying ceramic squares in a bathroom is interior decorating, but slates on a roof are laid the same way

explanation.definitionFit: Covering a surface with squares of ceramic or slate is the job of a tiler, indoors or on a roof.

parts.note: a holed vessel sounds like a sinking ship, but here it is a kitchen bowl full of holes on purpose

explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen strainer is a perforated bowl for draining vegetables or pasta.

clue.text: Powerful argument that can carry a lot of weight

definitions.meaning: a convincing line of reasoning in debate or law

definitions.text: that can carry a lot of weight
definitions.meaning: a sturdy suitcase able to hold a heavy load

explanation.definitionFit: A convincing argument and a sturdy piece of luggage share the same two-word phrase.

clue.text: You can put your shirt on this non-runner

definitions.text: You can put your shirt on this
definitions.meaning: a frame for drying or airing clothes literally holds shirts, while 'put your shirt on' is a betting idiom
a horse that does not run, a joke on the drying frame

explanation.definitionFit: A wooden frame for airing laundry holds shirts and is a horse that never races.

indicators.note: repeatedly tells us the short combination is written twice in succession

parts.note: a gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: A fish keeps turning out a wobbly dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: A gelatinous substance from seaweed is used to set desserts and culture media, a vegetable jelly.

definitions.meaning: an unexpected piece of good fortune, such as a sudden legacy
fruit blown down from a tree by the wind

explanation.definitionFit: An unexpected gain and fruit blown off a tree share one word.

parts.note: current means going, as in the going rate
concern is worry or anxiety

explanation.surface: Worries about the present state of affairs threaten a company's survival.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm operating profitably and expected to continue trading is a viable business.

indicators.note: distorted means the letters of the two words are twisted out of shape

explanation.surface: Something presents a twisted face, as in a funfair mirror.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary word for a person's face or countenance.

clue.text: Failing to join the other side

definitions.meaning: to desert one's country or party for the enemy

explanation.definitionFit: A flaw and the act of deserting to the enemy share one word.

indicators.note: dropping means one letter is let fall out of the flag's name

parts.note: the Red Ensign is the flag flown by British merchant ships

explanation.surface: A banner is to be rethought after its name is dropped.
explanation.walkthrough: The RED ENSIGN is the British merchant navy flag; 'dropping' takes out one N to leave the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To plan again or redraw a scheme is to work out its design afresh.

clue.text: I would go into disreputable place separate

indicators.note: go into means the shortened 'I would' is placed inside the word for the seedy venue

parts.note: a dive is a seedy bar or club
I'd, contracted, gives ID

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to enter a seedy haunt alone.
explanation.definitionFit: To split something into parts is to divide it.

clue.text: City with a well-known listed building

parts.words: City with a well-known listed building
parts.note: a listed building is a protected one, but here listed means leaning, as the famous tower does

parts.note: to proceed is to go
AD, anno domini, marks the present era

explanation.surface: Modern life urges people on to stir up trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To prod or provoke someone into action is to goad them, from the pointed stick for driving cattle.

clue.text: Surrender when not about to sum up

indicators.note: when not tells us the word for about is left out of the summing-up word

parts.note: to recapitulate is to summarise
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Giving in seems to mean declining to summarise.
explanation.definitionFit: To give in to an enemy on agreed terms is to surrender.

clue.text: Stream of learners having religious instruction first

indicators.note: first means the religious instruction letters come before the learners

parts.note: RI is the abbreviation for religious instruction, a British school subject
L is a learner, from the L-plate on a learner's car, so two learners give LL

explanation.surface: A group of pupils has scripture lessons before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: A small brook or rivulet is a stream.

parts.note: de is French for of
a basement is a cellar

explanation.surface: A French wine cellar is accused of watering down its stock.
explanation.definitionFit: Lowering the quality or purity of something is adulteration.
